q3_ephemeral_requirements.answer: MonetaConfig.ephemeral() needs the handle discipline to stay OFF the direct-construction path entirely.
facts: moneta_runtime.py:686-704 make_ephemeral() returns Moneta(MonetaConfig.ephemeral(**kwargs)) and NEVER touches _global_synapse or _MONETA_STORE.
PROVED by probe: MonetaConfig.ephemeral() emits moneta-ephemeral://<uuid4-hex>, unique per call (two calls -> two distinct URIs).

Every ephemeral test store is built as MonetaBackedStore(handle, embedder) DIRECTLY, bypassing from_storage_dir -- and therefore also bypassing the atexit.register(store.close) at moneta_store.py:377-378. The caller owns the lifetime; moneta_runtime.py:693-694 says so explicitly.

Dependent test modules (13): tests/test_moneta_crucible.py:38, tests/test_moneta_fc4_audit.py:34, tests/test_moneta_integration.py:91, tests/test_moneta_runtime.py:34,52,64,71,73, tests/test_moneta_store.py:36,119,133,268,289, tests/test_shadow_store.py:52, tests/test_sleep_pass_gate.py:96, tests/test_w3_evolve_consolidation.py:358, tests/test_w3_store_contract.py:265.
q3_ephemeral_requirements.requirement_for_forge: Any handle authority must be keyed by RESOLVED storage_uri (a registry), never a process-scalar, and must not intercept direct MonetaBackedStore(handle, embedder) construction. A scalar max-one-handle-per-process would break all 13 modules above -- this is adjudication D7. Because ephemeral URIs are already unique, a URI-keyed registry costs them nothing.
